pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: Trigger input (< 1/3 VCC sets output HIGH)

pins.name: OUT
pins.description: Timer output (Sink or source up to 200mA)

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: Active-LOW reset input (Tie to VCC if unused)

pins.description: Control voltage (Bypass to GND with 10nF cap)

pins.name: THRES
pins.description: Threshold input (> 2/3 VCC resets output LOW)
